note: Platform limits the content tools check in code. Each fact has its source. Anything not listed here is not stated as a number in member outputs.

instagram.hashtagsNote: Up to 5 hashtags per post or Reel since December 2025.
instagram.carouselNote: Up to 20 slides in the app since August 2024; scheduling tools that post through the API take up to 10. We make 10 or fewer so either way works.

x.note: Every link counts as 23 characters, whatever its real length.

threads.note: Text posts are limited to 500 characters; emoji count as their UTF-8 bytes. We write each post in plain text under 500.

email.canSpam: Include your physical postal address and a clear way to opt out, and honor opt-outs within 10 business days.

disclosure.rule: If a creator is paid, gets free product or has a personal or business tie to you, they disclose it in the post itself: "ad" or "sponsored" works, and on video it goes in the video, not only the description.

search.note: Google's public autocomplete endpoint (no key). Returns what people type, not how often. No robots.txt on the host. Cached 7 days, about 10 requests a run.

holidays.note: Federal holidays computed by their rule (2026 and 2027 dates match OPM). Observances like Mother's Day and Small Business Saturday are computed the same way.

exports.youtube: In YouTube Studio: Analytics, then Advanced mode (or See more), then Export current view.
exports.note: For other apps we only say that their insights or analytics pages can export post stats, and that a sheet typed by hand works the same. We never read stats from an app or a profile ourselves.
